Yip builds the ImTUI text backend and Dear ImGui core from the copy in
Korre commit 1000538d1a7e7d719d65a97ffde9c6985f4e040a, directory
`imtui`. The ImTUI headers were originally in `include/imtui`, its
renderer in `src`, and Dear ImGui in `third-party/imgui/imgui`.
The files are copied verbatim. Their license notices and the Korre
tree's license are included here. Examples and other backends are omitted.
